aboutMe: I am a systems analyst with training in Full Stack Web Development and experience in programming projects. Proficient in modern technologies, technical problem-solving, and hardware maintenance. Passionate about technology and continuous learning, seeking to contribute to the development of innovative technological solutions in collaborative environments.
contactDescription: Feel free to reach out for collaborations or just a friendly hello!

conectando.name: Conectando.com.ar
conectando.description: Conectando is a platform developed by Silicon Misiones that connects startups, entrepreneurs, and digital professionals. I contributed to the frontend development by building modern interfaces and improving user experience.

simi.name: Simi-access
simi.description: Access control and attendance management system for the Silicon Misiones business building. I developed fullstack features for entry/exit tracking, user management, and centralized attendance visualization.

sinam.name: SINAM
sinam.description: Web-based case management system for the children and adolescents rights defense office. I worked as a tester, ensuring quality through bug detection and validation of key functionalities.

spinlab.name: Spinlab
spinlab.description: SpinLab is a venture building program by Silicon Misiones focused on creating and accelerating science and technology startups. I contributed as a QA Tester and analyst, performing system-wide testing and requirements analysis to ensure reliability and support complex operational workflows.

alarms.name: Alarms
alarms.description: Alarm management application that allows users to create, edit, delete, and snooze reminders. I developed the backend with scheduled tasks (cron) and PostgreSQL, along with a modern interface built in Next.js.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Sticky notes application developed as a 3-day technical challenge. I built a React frontend and a Node.js/Express backend using PostgreSQL and Docker Compose.
